title: A dual model replacement backdoor attack method and system based on federated learning
assignee: Chongqing University of Post and Telecommunications

pse.problem: The invention aims to address the problem of dual model replacement backdoor attacks in federated learning, particularly focusing on the challenge of low concealment of triggers and single attack targets.
pse.solution_function: The invention presents a method for performing steganographic trigger generation, data poisoning, and model training in a coordinated manner to achieve multi-target backdoor attacks within federated learning. The system aims to improve the concealment of triggers and diversify attack targets.
pse.solution_structure: The key components include: (1) Trigger Generator for producing steganographic triggers, (2) Data Poisoning Module for adding the generated triggers into images in a reasonable manner, and (3) Model Training Module for training the backdoor model under federated learning.
pse.solution_implementation: The system first generates steganographic triggers using improved trigger generation methods. Then, it adds these triggers to images through Data Poisoning Module, aiming at multiple targets. Lastly, it trains the backdoor model using the poisoned data under federated learning in the Model Training Module.
pse.effect: The effect of this solution is the ability to perform multi-target backdoor attacks with increased concealment, enhancing the stealthiness and effectiveness of the attack.
